summary: The stated conditional theorem and scalable example are mathematically valid. The comparison array respects every original column capacity, including shared columns, and its paired entries satisfy all row moments. The accepted strict interpolation criterion applies to the complete vertex set in every affine rank; the distance perturbation exposes exactly the asserted whole face. Affineness makes the energy constant on that face, and circulation plus the external-column equalities bounds it by the comparison array's conditional entropy. The parity argument supplies the target-entropy bound. Singleton, empty-circulation, zero-diagonal-residual, and shared-column cases introduce no gap. The product example has the claimed extension, balanced saturated circulation, uniform entropy-selected target law, exact energy, and divergent lower bound.
